claims.quote: We imitate also flights of birds; we have some degrees of flying in the air.
claims.description: Heavier-than-air flight in a limited form.

claims.quote: We have ships and boats for going under water, and brooking of seas; also swimming-girdles and supporters.
claims.description: Submarines and swimming aids.

claims.quote: We have certain helps which set to the ear do further the hearing greatly.
claims.description: Hearing aids that improve hearing.

claims.quote: We have also means to convey sounds in trunks and pipes, in strange lines and distances.
claims.description: Conveying sound over long distances through pipes, a precursor of telephony.

claims.quote: We represent and imitate all articulate sounds and letters, and the voices and notes of beasts and birds.
claims.description: Artificial reproduction of human speech and animal sounds.

claims.quote: We imitate also motions of living creatures, by images, of men, beasts, birds, fishes, and serpents.
claims.description: Mechanical automata that imitate living creatures.

claims.quote: We have divers curious clocks, and other like motions of return: and some perpetual motions.
claims.description: Perpetual motion machines.

claims.quote: and to make them stronger and more violent than yours are; exceeding your greatest cannons and basilisks.
claims.description: Projectile weapons far more powerful than the largest cannons.

claims.quote: new mixtures and compositions of gun-powder, wild-fires burning in water, and unquenchable.
claims.description: New gunpowder compositions and incendiaries that burn in water and cannot be put out.

claims.quote: We find also divers means, yet unknown to you, of producing of light originally from divers bodies.
claims.description: New ways of generating light from various bodies, an early idea of artificial light sources.

claims.quote: We have also great and spacious houses where we imitate and demonstrate meteors; as snow, hail, rain, some artificial rains of bodies and not of water, thunders, lightnings
claims.description: Facilities that artificially produce weather phenomena.

claims.quote: We have also certain chambers, which we call Chambers of Health, where we qualify the air as we think good and proper for the cure of divers diseases, and preservation of health.
claims.description: Rooms with engineered air composition used to treat disease.

claims.quote: We have also pools, of which some do strain fresh water out of salt
claims.description: Desalination of seawater into fresh water.

claims.quote: being, by that we do to it made very sovereign for health, and prolongation of life.
claims.description: A treated water that improves health and extends life.

claims.quote: resuscitating of some that seem dead in appearance
claims.description: Reviving animals that appear dead, and keeping them alive after vital parts are removed.

claims.quote: trees and flowers to come earlier or later than their seasons
claims.description: Forcing plants to flower and fruit out of season and faster than natural growth.

claims.quote: We have also means to make divers plants rise by mixtures of earths without seeds
claims.description: Growing plants without seeds and creating new plant varieties, even turning one plant into another.

claims.quote: By art likewise, we make them greater or taller than their kind is; and contrariwise dwarf them, and stay their growth
claims.description: Deliberately altering animal size, fertility, color and shape.

claims.quote: We find means to make commixtures and copulations of different kinds; which have produced many new kinds, and them not barren, as the general opinion is.
claims.description: Creating fertile hybrid animal species by crossbreeding different kinds.

claims.quote: We make a number of kinds of serpents, worms, flies, fishes, of putrefaction; whereof some are advanced (in effect) to be perfect creatures, like bests or birds; and have sexes, and do propagate.
claims.description: Producing new living species from decaying matter, a form of artificial life.

claims.quote: of them put upon the back of your hand will, with a little stay, pass through to the palm, and yet taste mild to the mouth.
claims.description: Fluids that penetrate the skin, a precursor of transdermal drug delivery.

claims.quote: so that divers, especially in age, do desire to live with them, with little or no meat or bread.
claims.description: Nutritive drinks that serve as complete food replacing meat and bread.

claims.quote: We make divers imitations of taste likewise, so that they will deceive any man's taste.
claims.description: Artificial flavors and imitated tastes and smells.

claims.quote: which taken by men enable them to fast long after; and some other, that used make the very flesh of men's bodies sensibly more hard and tough and their strength far greater than otherwise it would be.
claims.description: Foods and drinks that enable long fasting and enhance strength, like performance-enhancing supplements.

claims.quote: And we do also declare natural divinations of diseases, plagues, swarms-of hurtful creatures, scarcity, tempests, earthquakes, great inundations, comets, temperature of the year, and divers other things
claims.description: Scientific forecasting of epidemics, famine, storms, earthquakes, floods and weather.

claims.quote: For upon every invention of value, we erect a statue to the inventor, and give him a liberal and honourable reward.
claims.description: An institution that systematically organizes research and honors and rewards inventors.
